name: Home Assistant, Entities
description: A status grid of several Home Assistant entities. Each row tints by its state (on / off / other), leads with a device-class-aware Phosphor glyph (temperature → thermometer, CO₂ → wind, motion → person walking, …), and shows its current value. Rows that changed within the last 10 minutes pick up an accent-4 wash + a 'just now' / 'Nm ago' badge.

cell_options.name: overrides
cell_options.label: Custom names + icons
cell_options.help: One row per ticked entity. Leave the name blank to keep the auto label; pick "No icon" to keep the auto icon.
